title: Delete key doesn't delete a selected vector shape (subselection vs standard-selection mismatch)
description:
FIXED. Root cause + fix below; verified by build + authoring-ui suite (1165/1165) + new regression tests.

== ROOT CAUSE ==
Exactly the selection-model mismatch described: the planar-merge P5 cutover routes Selection-tool vector-shape clicks through the SUBSELECTION model (StageArea.tsx:2620 partialSelectEnabled branch -> onSubSelect, returns before onShapeSelect), so selectedShapeIds stays []. Delete consulted ONLY selectedShapeIds in TWO places:
 1. commands/editor.ts hasSelection() gated edit.delete's isEnabled on selectedShapeIds.length>0 -> command DISABLED for a vector shape (dispatch early-returns).
 2. Shell.tsx handleDeleteSelected early-returned on selectedShapeIds.length===0 and never consulted subSelection.

== FIX ==
1. commands/editor.ts hasSelection(): now returns true for EITHER selectedShapeIds OR a non-empty subSelection -> edit.delete enabled for a selected vector shape.
2. Shell.tsx: new handleDeleteSubSelection() -- when selectedShapeIds is empty but a subSelection exists, deletes the selected face(s)/segment(s). handleDeleteSelected falls through to it when the standard selection is empty. One pushDoc = one undo step; clears the subSelection.
3. core: new exported deleteSubSelection(ps, keys, remainderId) in engine/planar/split.ts = splitOnMove(...,0,0) keeping only the REMAINDER (extracted half discarded). Single-fill rect = one face -> remainder null -> whole display object removed (matches the e2e repro: draw rect, select, Delete -> shape gone). Partial subselection -> remainder keeps the rest (only the sub-shape removed), authentic Flash 8.

Standard selection (text / symbol instances) path is UNCHANGED -> no regression. The redundant StageArea Delete handler is gated on selectedShapeIds/selectedShapeId so it stays a no-op for the subselection case (no double-delete).

== VERIFICATION ==
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: GREEN (full ordered).
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test --run: 98 files / 1165 tests PASS (exit 0).
- core planar tests (subselection/merge/eraser): 58/58 PASS.
- New regression: packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/deleteSubSelection.test.ts (3 cases: single-fill rect Delete removes it from the doc; two-colour merged shape Delete removes ONLY the picked face, keeps the other half; double-click connected Delete removes the region) + 4 cases in commandsIntegration.test.ts (edit.delete isEnabled: false with nothing; true via selectedShapeIds; true via subSelection; dispatch delegates to deleteSelected).
- ACCEPTABLE pre-existing failures: 3 core FLA test files (empty-bytematch / carchive-validate / contents-structure) fail ENOENT on fixtures/flash8-empty.fla -- that fixture is untracked/absent in this environment (not in git, not in main checkout); unrelated to this change (no FLA code touched). Matches the ~3-fixture allowance.
